_comment: PRIMORDIA is a persistent world, not a stateless dev server. One instance owns
state/checkpoint_latest.* and has been running continuously for 12,000+ simulated
years; a second instance would race it for the same checkpoint. So the default
config ATTACHES to the running sim rather than starting one.
Port 8710 is not incidental and autoPort must stay false: the game-master, the
check-in schedule, CLAUDE.md and every tool address 127.0.0.1:8710 directly.
If nothing is running, start it detached (so it outlives the session) with:
or use the 'primordia-start' config below, which holds the world in the foreground.
The previous version of this file passed --size 192 --max-pop 12000, which would
have tried to bootstrap a 192-cell world against a 384-cell save. It also wrote
'.venv\Scripts\python.exe' with a single backslash, which is not valid JSON escaping.
